cumleler: Which change counts as significant in ototoxicity monitoring?
The American Speech-Language-Hearing Association, or ASHA, defines three criteria.
First, a worsening of 20 decibels or more at any frequency.
Second, 10 decibels or more at two adjacent frequencies.
Third, loss of response at three consecutive frequencies that previously responded.
Whichever is met, the change is not reported until retesting confirms it.
